book.name: Luka
book.title: Cau amsǝban a nê mala LUKA

content: Pǝlǝ nzǝ́mó arǝ cauɓikea ko wu kiɗiki
A pwari mǝno ka, aɓea ɓwana nakam àkǝ̀ banì, à ne Yesu cau mala amǝ Galili mǝnana à ndarǝ pa gir'nkila aban Ɓakuli sǝ Bilatus tsǝa à wal-luia ka.
Pǝlǝa Yesu nea wia ama:

content.text: Wu kǝ sǝni kǝla amǝnia yì amǝ Galili à walia ka à nda ka amǝnana à kútí acili amǝ Galili nǝ cauɓikea ka le?
Awo! Ən nggǝ na wun, ɓǝ̀ wu nying pakki acauɓikea, wu nyare aban Ɓakuli raka, wu nǝ̀ wú kat gbal.
Ko aɓwana mǝnana lum-bwamdǝ-tongno-nong-tàrú mǝnana ndà-kulí mǝ'dāhre kpa a múrià à wú a Silowam ngga, wu kǝ sǝni kǝla à kútìban nǝ cauɓikea a Urǝshalima kat le?
Awo! Ən nggǝ na wun, ɓǝ̀ wu nying pakki acauɓikea wu nyare aban Ɓakuli raka, wu nǝ̀ wú kat gbal.

content: Kanicau arǝ vwari mana kǝ ɓǝl raka
Pǝlǝa Yesu nea wia mǝnia yì kanicau ka ama:

content.text: Ɓè ɓwa ndanǝ nggun vwari a ɓaban male. Waria alta ɓǝle sǝ ko kya kum ɗang.
Sǝ ne ɓwa mǝnana kǝ yál ɓaban ngga ama, <<Pǝlǝa tàrú yalung mǝ ndarǝ nyarki kani ace alta ɓǝla vwari mǝnia ka, sǝ ko ǝn kum ɗang. Kasǝi turi! Ace mana sǝ nǝ̀ nggǝ kiɗiki nzali ɓà?>>
Sǝ mǝ'yál ɓaban ne wi ama, <<Mǝtala-ɓala, ɗeki ɓǝ̀ pǝlǝa mǝnia ka ɓǝ̀ malâ, mǝ nǝ kwarki nzali mǝnana a tǝte ka, sǝ mǝ nǝ soapi wi ciunda.
Ɓǝ̀ pusǝ ɓǝle aɓa pǝlǝa mǝnana kǝ yiu ka, yàwá! Ɓǝ̀ ɓǝl ɗǝm raka, sǝ wu kasǝi.>>

content: Yesu twalban rǝkwana a pwari Sabbat
A pwari usǝlǝo mala amǝ Yahudi ka, Yesu na aban kani aɓwana gir aɓa ɓe ndakpapi.
Ɓè ɓwama nakam kukwar gbakǝri pǝlǝa lum-bwamdǝ-tongno-nong-tàrú. Kàrrì kàngkàng, gandǝ sárǝ́ rǝì ɗang ko bǝti.
Lang Yesu nǝ̀ sǝni ka, pǝlǝa tunǝi ama ɓǝ̀ yiu a dǝmba, sǝ ne wi ama,

content.text: <<Ɓwama, à panzǝno a bu mǝnia yì kwánó mo ka.>>

content: Pǝlǝa tsǝk abui arǝì, anggo ka, kara sárǝ́ pǝrapǝra, kǝ ɓwangsǝki Ɓakuli.

Sǝ ɓwamǝgule ndakpapi ka bumi lúllô, acemǝnana Yesu twalban rǝkwana a pwari usǝlǝo ka. Ne aɓwana mana à ram ngga ama, <<Anongŋo ndakam tongno-nong-mwashat ace túró. Wu yiu ɓǝà twala wun ban arǝkwana ma'wun aɓalǝ amǝno yì apwari ka, wu kǝa yiu a pwari usǝlǝo ɗàng.>>
Mǝtalabangŋo pǝlǝi wi ama,

content.text: <<Wun amǝ'kúnɓárína! Ko yan aɓalǝ wun ngga kǝ panzǝ jamnda ko dambǝritso male a domwan kǝ um nǝi a pe wi mùr a pwari usǝlǝo re?
Sǝ ado ka, mǝnia yì ɓwama, Mǝkà Ibǝrayim, mǝnana Shetan kùrrì pǝlǝa lum-bwamdǝ-tongno-nong-tàrú ka, à pà nǝ̀ panzǝi a pwari usǝlǝo re?>>

content: Lang bangŋǝna anggo ka, kara kǝsǝkya pakki aɓi-mǝbura. Sǝ aɓwana ka banɓoaria wia nǝ agir-ndǝlǝki mǝnana pea ka.
Kanicau arǝ mǝsǝ musta andǝ yis
Pǝlǝa Yesu ɗiban ama,

content.text: <<Domurǝm mala Ɓakuli ka nda kǝla mana? Mǝ nǝ kànì arǝ mana?
Nda kǝla mǝsǝ musta mǝnana ndya mǝní bǝti, mǝnana ɓeɓwa twali kya ɓeali a ɓaban male ka. Gulo kya pǝlǝa nggun sǝ amuna-nyal mana a kùli ka à yì bwal ndà arǝ abuí.>>

content: Nyare ɗiban ama,

content.text: <<Arǝ mana sǝ mǝ nǝ kani Domurǝm mala Ɓakuli?
Nda kǝla yis mǝnana ɓè ɓwama twal bǝti, sùrǝì andǝ muku mǝsǝbondo alkama tasau tàrú, pǝlǝa loakio aki ɓālǝi kat ka.>>

content: Kunkurǝm mǝɓweari
Yesu kutio arǝ alá andǝ amuna-là aban kani aɓwana gìr, dǝshi muri aban ká Urǝshalima.
Pǝlǝa ɓeɓwa ɗì ama, <<Mǝtalabangŋo, aɓwana bǝti na à nǝ̀ amsǝia ka le?>> Yesu nea wia ama:

content.text: Wu ɓariki wu kutio a kunkurǝm mǝnana ɓwear ka, ǝn nggǝ na wun, acemǝnana aɓwana pas à nǝ̀ ɓariki ama à nǝ̀ kutio, sǝ à pà nǝ̀ gandǝi ɗang.
Sǝ ɓǝ̀ mǝtala-ɓala longŋǝna sǝ girǝna kunɓala ka, wun nǝ̀ cam nǝ nza sǝ wun nǝ̀ nggǝ walki kunɓala aban zǝmba ama, <<Ɓwamǝgule, mǝnba sǝm kunɓala!>>
Sǝ yì ka, nǝ̀ eare ama, <<Ən súrǝ̀ wun ɗang, sǝ ǝn súrǝ̀ ban mǝnana wu pur kam ngga ɗang!>>
Sǝ wun nǝ̀ na ama, <<Sǝm li, sǝ sǝm nu, sǝnǝa wun, sǝ a kanì aɓwana gir arǝ anreɓala ma'sǝm.>>
Sǝ nǝ̀ eara wun ama, <<Ən súrǝ̀ wun ɗang, sǝ ǝn súrǝ̀ ban mǝnana wu pur kam ngga ɗang. Wu upi banam, wun amǝ'ɓealɓikea!>>
Akàm wun nǝ̀ nggǝ ɓua nǝ nǝmnggi munabu wun, ɓǝ̀ wu sǝna Ibǝrayim, andǝ Ishaku andǝ Yakupu andǝ amǝ'ɓangnǝa mala Ɓakuli kat aɓa Domurǝm mala Ɓakuli, sǝ wun ngga à ɗekina wun nǝ nza ka.
Ɓwapǝndǝa nǝ̀ pur nǝ njar-takuli, nǝ njar-nzali, nǝ njar-nza andǝ njar-kunmur, à nǝ̀ yia do aban lìli banɓoarnado a Domurǝm mala Ɓakuli.
A pwari mǝno ka, aɓea aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ gusǝlǝ cea ado ka à nǝ̀ kyauwikia, sǝ aɓea aɓwana mǝnana à kǝ kyauwikia ado ka à nǝ̀ gusǝlia.

content: Yesu pak bumkiɗikea amur Urǝshalima
Anggo ka aɓea amǝ Farisi yiu aban Yesu à yì ne wi ama, <<Nying ban mǝnia ka, o a ɓe ban ɗàng. Hirǝdus kǝ earce wal-luio.>>
Pǝlǝa Yesu nea wia ama:

content.text: Wu kyane wu kya ne mǝno yì mǝ'nyamshaminu ka ama, <<Mǝ nǝ pusǝ akukwar, mǝ nǝ twali aɓwana ban rǝkwana yalung andǝ li, sǝ a tàruià nongŋo ka, mǝ nǝ masǝlǝta túró mem.
Kat andǝ amani ka, mǝ nda amur gya yalung andǝ li sǝ liawo. Mǝsǝcau ka à nǝ̀ wal-lú kǝ mǝɓangnǝa mala Ɓakuli sǝ pà aɓa Urǝshalima ɗang re!>>

Wun amǝ Urǝshalima! Wun amǝ Urǝshalima! Wun mǝnana wu kǝ wal-lú amǝ'ɓangnǝa mala Ɓakuli ka. Aɓwana mǝnana à túriá aban wun ngga wu kǝ ɓukkia nǝ atali, ɓǝa wú. Kusǝ shen Mǝ nda ban earce ram wun aban mǝ'mwashati, kǝla mǝnana nggu kǝ ramgi amuni aɓata ankpamtari ka, sǝ wu ear ɗang.

Wu sǝni, Ndàmǝgule ma'wun ngga, Ɓakuli ginǝkina wuni, nongŋǝna atàrǝì. Ən nggǝ na wun, pà wu nǝ̀ nyare wun nǝ̀ sǝnam ɗǝm ɗàng. She pwari mǝnana wun nǝ̀ bang ama, <<Ɓwangsǝban mala Ɓakuli na amur ɓwa mǝnana kǝ yiu aɓa lullǝ Mǝtalabangŋo ka!>>
